_comment: The front door prototype's numbers (docs/design/front-door.md, section 3). card_min_px is the narrowest an update card may be before the row drops a card; it was chosen by the measurement in section 3 (the last 100 release headlines, measured at each width in the page's own font). Below two cards side by side the row becomes a swipe row of card_max cards. There is no chat slice (the operator, 2026-11-02), so no chat numbers.
